name: resize_for_platforms
description: Resize and export a source image to multiple social-platform sizes using named presets (e.g. instagram_post, youtube_thumbnail).

sourcePath.description: Workspace-relative path to the source image.

presets.description: Named sizes: instagram_post, instagram_story, twitter_post, linkedin_post, facebook_cover, youtube_thumbnail, open_graph.

outputDir.description: Directory prefix for outputs (e.g. exports/). Default exports/.
